card.name: Table numbers and CYP3A in labels
card.fires_on: Short label-text pieces: the table number after 'presented in Table', the 'A' in CYP3A before 'inhibitor', and 'see' in bracketed cross-references like '[see Adverse Reactions'.

modes.label: Table number
modes.description: A digit right after 'presented in Table' in a results section.
modes.example: placebo-controlled schizophrenia studies are presented in Table <<6>>.

modes.label: CYP3A letter
modes.description: The letter A completing CYP3A before 'inhibitors' in interaction guidance.
modes.example: Dose Modifications for Use With Strong CYP3<<A>> Inhibitors Avoid concomitant use

modes.label: Bracketed see
modes.description: The word 'see' opening a cross-reference to a section number.
modes.example: In the pooled safety population [<<see>> Adverse Reactions (6.1
